_about: Filing-verified decision pages re-read 2026-11-18: for each, the sentence in the cited filing (or the company release it furnishes) that records the FDA action, and where it is. Quotes are excerpts of at most ~125 characters. Written into _decision_verification.json by apply_1118c_filing_quotes.py; required by tests/test_decision_filing_evidence.py. `retract`: ledger entries still marked verified for pages that were already retired (no page, a redirect in vercel.json) and whose cited filing, re-read 2026-11-18, records no FDA action on that date; they are marked retracted with the finding.

ABEO-2025-04-29.quote: today announced the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved ZEVASKYN™
ABEO-2025-04-29.note: Abeona press release dated April 29, 2025 announcing approval of ZEVASKYN (prademagene zamikeracel). Quote is an excerpt (WebFetch limits quotes to ~125 chars).

BNTX-2025-08-27.quote: COMIRNATY® Receives U.S. FDA Approval for Adults 65 and Older
BNTX-2025-08-27.note: BioNTech/Pfizer 6-K dated Aug 27, 2025: FDA approved the sBLA for the LP.8.1-adapted 2025-2026 COMIRNATY formula. Quote is the release headline.

ETON-2026-02-25.quote: today announced the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of a New Drug Application (NDA) for DESMODA™
ETON-2026-02-25.note: Eton release dated Feb 25, 2026: FDA approval of DESMODA (desmopressin acetate) oral solution. Page asset field is blank; drug is DESMODA.

GSK-2025-07-17.quote: US FDA approves GSK's Shingrix in a prefilled syringe presentation
GSK-2025-07-17.note: GSK release dated 17 July 2025. Quote is the headline.

NVAX-2025-08-27.quote: approved the supplemental Biologics License Application (“BLA”) for the Nuvaxovid
NVAX-2025-08-27.note: Novavax 8-K: 'On August 27, 2025 the Company announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) approved' the sBLA for the Nuvaxovid 2025-2026 formula. Quote is an excerpt.

NVS-2025-11-24.quote: Novartis today announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Itvisma (onasemnogene abeparvovec-brve)
NVS-2025-11-24.note: Novartis release, Basel, November 24, 2025 (6-K filed Nov 25).

OTLK-2025-12-31.quote: FDA issues Complete Response Letter (CRL) for resubmitted ONS-5010 BLA
OTLK-2025-12-31.note: Outlook release dated Dec 31, 2025: CRL for resubmitted ONS-5010/LYTENAVA (bevacizumab-vikg) BLA. No separate CRL date stated; quote is a headline/subheading.

RARE-2025-07-11.quote: has issued a Complete Response Letter (“CRL”) for its Biologics License Application (“BLA”) for UX111
RARE-2025-07-11.note: Ultragenyx 8-K dated July 11, 2025. No separate CRL issue date stated.

REGN-2025-04-20.quote: In April 2025, the FDA issued a CRL regarding the sBLA for the addition of extended dosing intervals.
REGN-2025-04-20.note: CAVEAT: Regeneron Q1 2025 results release dated Apr 29, 2025 (9 days after page date). It records the extended-dosing-interval CRL only as 'In April 2025' and says the data did not support intervals greater than every 16 weeks; the specific day (Apr 20) is not confirmed by this filing. The same release separately records a CRL for the EYLEA HD pre-filled syringe on April 23, 2025 (different application).

SNY-2026-02-24.quote: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Dupixent (dupilumab)
SNY-2026-02-24.note: Sanofi/Regeneron release, Paris and Tarrytown, Feb 24, 2026: Dupixent approved for allergic fungal rhinosinusitis (AFRS). Page asset field is blank; drug is Dupixent. 6-K filed Mar 3.

SRRK-2025-09-23.quote: Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the apitegromab Biologics License Application
SRRK-2025-09-23.note: Scholar Rock release dated Sep 23, 2025; CRL tied to Catalent Indiana fill-finish facility inspection.

TLX-2025-04-28.quote: Complete Response Letter (CRL) from the United States (U.S.) Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
TLX-2025-04-28.note: Telix release dated 28 April 2025: Telix received a CRL from the FDA for the TLX101-CDx NDA. Headline: 'Telix Provides Regulatory Update on TLX101-CDx'.

ALVO-2025-11-02.quote: has issued a complete response letter (CRL) for Alvotech’s Biologics License Application (BLA) for AVT05
ALVO-2025-11-02.note: Alvotech 6-K (signed Nov 2, 2025) furnishing release announcing CRL for AVT05 (golimumab biosimilar). No separate CRL issue date stated.

ATRA-2026-01-12.quote: Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the EBVALLO (tabelecleucel) Biologics License Application
ATRA-2026-01-12.note: Atara release (Jan 12, 2026). Release says the CRL was received after market close on 9 January 2026, 3 days before the page date (within tolerance; page could use Jan 9).

CORT-2025-12-31.quote: Corcept Receives Complete Response Letter for Relacorilant as a Treatment for Patients with Hypercortisolism
CORT-2025-12-31.note: Corcept release dated Dec 31, 2025. Quote is the headline.

ADMA-2026-05-04.quote: FDA Approval to Expand the Label for ASCENIV
ADMA-2026-05-04.note: ADMA release dated May 4, 2026: sBLA approval expanding ASCENIV PI indication to patients 2 years and older. Quote is the start of the headline.

ALDX-2026-03-17.quote: on March 17, 2026, Aldeyra announced receipt of the 2026 Complete Response Letter
ALDX-2026-03-17.note: Aldeyra 8-K dated Mar 17, 2026: second CRL for the reproxalap NDA (dry eye disease); PDUFA had been extended to Mar 16, 2026. Quote does not itself name reproxalap; the filing elsewhere refers to 'the reproxalap NDA'.

ARGX-2026-05-08.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved a label expansion for VYVGART®
ARGX-2026-05-08.note: argenx release dated May 8, 2026 (6-K filed May 11): label expansion of VYVGART and VYVGART Hytrulo to gMG of all serotypes (ADAPT SERON).

ARVN-2026-05-01.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted approval for VEPPANU (vepdegestrant)
ARVN-2026-05-01.note: Arvinas/Pfizer release dated May 1, 2026; approval came ahead of June 5, 2026 PDUFA date.

ASND-2026-02-27.quote: FDA has granted approval under the FDA’s Accelerated Approval Program for YUVIWEL
ASND-2026-02-27.note: Ascendis 6-K (signed Mar 2, 2026) says the approval was announced Feb 27, 2026.

AXSM-2026-04-30.quote: has approved AUVELITY® (dextromethorphan HBr and bupropion HCl) for the treatment of agitation associated with dementia
AXSM-2026-04-30.note: Axsome release dated Apr 30, 2026: new indication (Alzheimer's agitation) for AUVELITY.

AZN-2026-04-28.quote: Breztri approved in the US for asthma as first and only triple therapy for patients 12 years of age and older
AZN-2026-04-28.note: AstraZeneca release dated 28 April 2026 (asthma indication). No specific approval date in text; page title says Apr 27, slug Apr 28 - both within tolerance.

AZN-2026-05-22.quote: Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan) has been approved in the US
AZN-2026-05-22.note: CAVEAT: AstraZeneca release in the 6-K is datelined 26 May 2026 ('Today's approval'), 4 days after the page date, so by the filing alone this is WRONG_DATE. But OncLive (published May 22, 2026, citing a Daiichi Sankyo release dated May 22, 2026) shows the approval was announced May 22; AZ announced after the UK/US bank-holiday weekend. Page date appears correct; the filing is a late announcement. 1L TNBC indication (TROPION-Breast02).

AZN-2026-06-12.quote: Truqap (capivasertib) in combination with abiraterone and prednisone has been approved in the US
AZN-2026-06-12.note: AstraZeneca release dated 15 June 2026 ('Today's landmark approval'); no specific FDA action date in text. 3 days after page date (Fri Jun 12 -> Mon Jun 15), within tolerance.

CING-2026-06-02.quote: Cingulate Receives Complete Response Letter from FDA for CTx-1301
CING-2026-06-02.note: Cingulate release dated June 2, 2026; PDUFA target date was May 31, 2026; CRL issue date not stated. Quote is the headline.

DNLI-2026-03-25.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted accelerated approval for AVLAYAH™ (tividenofusp alfa-eknm)
DNLI-2026-03-25.note: Denali release dated Mar 25, 2026; page title says Mar 24, slug Mar 25 - within tolerance.

GRCE-2026-04-23.quote: has issued a Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the Company's New Drug Application (NDA) for GTx-104
GRCE-2026-04-23.note: Grace Therapeutics release dated Apr 23, 2026. Apostrophe in quote may be a curly quote in the original.

GSK-2026-03-19.quote: the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Lynavoy (linerixibat) for the treatment of cholestatic pruritus
GSK-2026-03-19.note: GSK release, London, 19 March 2026 ('today'). Page title says 'Approved Mar 17' while slug and filing say Mar 19; title day is unsupported by this filing (2-day gap, within tolerance).

GSK-2026-06-17.quote: the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Utebzi
GSK-2026-06-17.note: GSK/Spero release, London, 17 June 2026: Utebzi (tebipenem pivoxil) approved for cUTI. Same drug as page asset 'Tebipenem HBr (SPR994)'.

IONS-2026-06-24.quote: TRYNGOLZA® (olezarsen) approved by the FDA as the first and only treatment
IONS-2026-06-24.note: Ionis release, Carlsbad, June 24, 2026: sHTG indication for TRYNGOLZA (olezarsen).

NVO-2026-03-19.quote: the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Wegovy® HD
NVO-2026-03-19.note: Novo Nordisk release, Bagsvaerd, 19 March 2026 (6-K filed Mar 20): Wegovy HD 7.2 mg.

ONC-2026-05-13.quote: BEQALZI™ (sonrotoclax) Approved by U.S. FDA as First and Only BCL2 Inhibitor for R/R Mantle Cell Lymphoma
ONC-2026-05-13.note: BeOne Medicines release, San Carlos, May 13, 2026 (filed May 15): accelerated approval. Quote is the headline.

RCKT-2026-03-27.quote: has granted accelerated approval for KRESLADI™
RCKT-2026-03-27.note: Rocket release, Cranbury NJ, March 27, 2026: accelerated approval of KRESLADI (marnetegragene autotemcel) for LAD-I.

REPL-2026-04-10.quote: Complete Response Letter regarding the Biologics License Application (“BLA”) for RP1 (vusolimogene oderparepvec)
REPL-2026-04-10.note: Replimune 8-K dated April 10, 2026: second CRL, received April 10, 2026 (filed Apr 13).

SPRO-2026-06-17.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) has granted approval for Utebzi (tebipenem pivoxil)
SPRO-2026-06-17.note: Spero 8-K (event June 17, 2026, signed June 22) furnishing June 17 release; approval came ahead of the June 18, 2026 PDUFA date.

VNDA-2026-02-20.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved BYSANTI
VNDA-2026-02-20.note: Vanda release, Washington, February 20, 2026 (8-K filed Feb 23): BYSANTI (milsaperidone) tablets. Quote stops before a trademark symbol.

VRDN-2026-06-26.quote: has approved Lumvoa™ (veligrotug-vvze) for the treatment of thyroid eye disease
VRDN-2026-06-26.note: Viridian release (Business Wire, Waltham; 8-K filed June 29, 2026) records FDA approval of Lumvoa (veligrotug-vvze). Release prints no date and no approval date; it announces a call for Monday, June 29, consistent with a June 26-28 announcement. Page date not contradicted but not confirmed by the filing.

AZN-2026-06-30: The cited AstraZeneca filing reports a European Commission approval of Enhertu, not an FDA action.
JAGX-2026-04-29: The cited exhibit is about a Nasdaq listing extension and a reverse stock split. No FDA approval or CRL.
LGND-2026-06-08: The cited 8-K reports the votes at Ligand's June 5, 2026 annual meeting; it names no drug and no FDA action.
SPRY-2026-05-15: The cited exhibit is ARS Pharmaceuticals' first-quarter 2026 investor presentation. No FDA action in May 2026.
GSK-2026-06-18: A second entry for the Utebzi approval announced June 17, 2026 (GSK-2026-06-17). June 18 was the target date.
SPRO-2026-06-18: A second entry for the Utebzi approval announced June 17, 2026 (SPRO-2026-06-17).
NVCR-2026-02-12: A second entry for the Optune Pax approval announced February 11, 2026 after the close (NVCR-2026-02-11).
VRDN-2026-06-29: A second entry for the Lumvoa approval announced June 26, 2026 (VRDN-2026-06-26). June 29 is the 8-K filing date.
VRDN-2026-06-30: A third entry for the Lumvoa approval announced June 26, 2026 (VRDN-2026-06-26).
